title.en: Keep up with a fast voice chat
title.es: Seguir una charla rápida entre amigos

es: Seguir un chat de voz grupal a ritmo natural y responder con datos exactos, una razón y una contrapropuesta en registro informal.

teaching.en: I'm gonna book the tickets tonight, so count me in.
teaching.es: Voy a reservar las entradas esta noche, así que cuenta conmigo.
teaching.explanationEs: Count me in significa que aceptas unirte al plan.
teaching.audioText: I'm gonna book the tickets tonight, so count me in.

teaching.en: Sunday at noon works for me, so it's a deal.
teaching.es: El domingo a mediodía me viene bien, así que hecho.
teaching.explanationEs: Works for me acepta una propuesta; deal cierra el acuerdo.
teaching.audioText: Sunday at noon works for me, so it's a deal.

teaching.en: Can we swap Saturday for Sunday? I gotta work until six.
teaching.es: ¿Podemos cambiar el sábado por el domingo? Tengo que trabajar hasta las seis.
teaching.explanationEs: Swap A for B: cambiar una cosa por otra, con la razón detrás.
segments: Can we swap Saturday for Sunday?
teaching.audioText: Can we swap Saturday for Sunday? I gotta work until six.

teaching.en: No worries, we can go on Sunday instead.
teaching.es: No pasa nada, podemos ir el domingo en su lugar.
teaching.explanationEs: No worries quita tensión y acepta el cambio.
teaching.audioText: No worries, we can go on Sunday instead.

teaching.en: I can't make it on Saturday, so let's swap days, or I can take a rain check.
teaching.es: No puedo ir el sábado, así que cambiemos de día, o lo dejamos para otra ocasión.
teaching.explanationEs: Take a rain check: rechazar ahora y proponer quedar otro día.
segments: I can't make it on Saturday, so let's swap
days, or I can take a rain check.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de Mia y elige qué hará esta noche.

feedback.es: I'm gonna book es un plan: Mia va a reservar las entradas.

hint.es: Gonna es going to: habla de un plan.

origin.audio: Mia says: I'm gonna book the tickets tonight. The concert is on Saturday at seven thirty. Who's in?

prompt.es: Leo escribe «Count me in». ¿Qué quiere decir?

choices.text: He wants to join the plan.
He wants to cancel the plan.
He wants to count the tickets.

feedback.es: Count me in es una forma informal de aceptar unirse a un plan.

hint.es: Es lo que dices cuando quieres participar.

prompt.es: Ordena: «El domingo a mediodía me viene bien.»

answer.text: Sunday at noon works for me

feedback.es: Works for me acepta una propuesta; la hora va antes del verbo.

prompt.es: Escucha el chat y elige qué propone Tom.

choices.text: To move the plan to Sunday at midday.

feedback.es: Tom rechaza el sábado y contrapropone el domingo a mediodía.

origin.audio: Tom says: Saturday doesn't work for me. I gotta work until six. What about Sunday at noon? Sara says: Sunday works for me. Leo says: Sunday is fine, but I can't be there before one.

prompt.es: Escucha el chat otra vez y elige por qué Tom no puede el sábado.

choices.text: He has no money for the tickets.
He has a job shift until the evening.

feedback.es: Tom da su razón con I gotta work until six: tiene que trabajar hasta las seis.

origin.audio: Tom says: Saturday doesn't work for me. I gotta work until six. What about Sunday at noon? Sara says: Sunday works for me. Leo says: Sunday is fine, but I can't be there before one.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada expresión del chat con su función.

pairs.es: Dejas el plan para otra ocasión

feedback.es: Cada expresión tiene una función social: aceptar, tranquilizar o aplazar.

prompt.es: Escucha el chat y elige qué precio por entrada da Sara.

feedback.es: Sara da el precio, fifty pounds; thirty es el precio de las entradas baratas que propone Leo.

feedback.es: Mia propone quedar en la estación a las seis y cuarenta y cinco; siete treinta es la hora del concierto.

feedback.es: Tom razona que cincuenta es mucho y propone cambiar a las entradas baratas.

prompt.es: Responde al chat: acepta, da datos exactos y contrapropón una hora con una razón.

answer.text: Hey everyone! Count me in for Saturday. The concert starts at seven thirty, so we can't be late. Fifty pounds each is kinda expensive, but no worries, I'll pay. Lemme ask something: can we meet at the station at half past six instead of six? I gotta finish work at six, and the station is ten minutes away. Also, what about buying the cheap seats? They're thirty pounds, so we'd save money. If it rains, we can take the bus instead. Sara, could you book the tickets tonight? Let me know, thanks! I'm really looking forward to it, and I think it's gonna be a great night. See you all on Saturday!

Hi all! I'm in for Saturday. The concert starts at seven thirty, so we gotta be on time. Fifty pounds each is a lot, but it's a deal, I'll come. Can we meet at the station at six thirty instead of six? I gotta work until six, and I need time to get there. What about taking the bus instead of a taxi? It's cheaper. Mia, are you gonna book the tickets tonight? Let me know! I'm really looking forward to it, and I think it's gonna be a great night. If it rains, we can take an umbrella and go anyway. See you all on Saturday!

Hello everyone! Count me in. The concert is at half past seven and the tickets are 50 pounds each, so let's be careful with money. I dunno if six works for me, because I gotta finish work first. Can we meet at 6.30 instead? I'll take the bus and arrive on time. No worries if that is a problem, just tell me. Who's gonna book the tickets? I can do it tonight if you want. I'm really looking forward to it, and I think it's gonna be a great night. If it rains, we can take an umbrella and go anyway. See you all on Saturday!

feedback.es: La respuesta acepta el plan, repite hora y precio, propone una hora nueva con su razón y usa formas informales.

origin.text: Mensajes del chat — Mia: «The concert is on Saturday at seven thirty. Who's in?» Leo: «The tickets are fifty pounds each.» Tom: «Let's meet at the station at six.» Responde en registro informal: acepta el plan, repite la hora del concierto y el precio, y contrapropón otra hora de encuentro con tu razón. Usa al menos una forma reducida.
